 Replay: Afghanistan vs Zimbabwe, 1st Test, Day 1
 101.3 Ziaur Rahman Sharifi to Tafadzwa Tsiga, no run, a good length delivery outside off, Tafadzwa Tsiga has a poke, gets beaten as the ball holds its line Tafadzwa Tsiga, right handed bat, comes to the crease 101.2 W Ziaur Rahman Sharifi to Madhevere, out Caught by Ikram Alikhil!! The short ball ploy has worked. Banged in short from round the wicket and Wessly Madhevere fails to get out of its way on this occasion. Was slightly late in reacting and the ball clips the splice of his bat and lobs right up in the air. Alikhil - the keeper, calls for it and jogs forward to complete a safe catch. Sharifi with his first wicket of the match as he breaks the 96-run partnership.. Madhevere c Ikram Alikhil b Ziaur Rahman Sharifi 54(70) [4s-9] Ziaur Rahman Sharifi to Madhevere, THATS OUT!! Caught!! 101.1 Ziaur Rahman Sharifi to Brian Bennett, 1 run, this time he has pulled the short ball towards the fielder at fine leg Over 101 382-5 0 1 0 0 4 0 ( 5 runs) Wessly Madhevere 54 (69) Brian Bennett 97 (174) Mohammad Saleem Safi 22-5-65-1 Over Summary View all overs 100.6 Saleem Safi to Madhevere, no run, shortish delivery down the leg-side, Wessly Madhevere lets it through to the keeper 100.5 4 Saleem Safi to Madhevere, FOUR , full and wide outside off, Wessly Madhevere leans forward and drills it through cover for a rollicking boundary. He's looking in top form. The partnership is inching closer to the 100-run mark 100.4 Saleem Safi to Madhevere, no run, another lovely delivery, short and quick around middle and leg, Wessly Madhevere sways away once again 100.3 Saleem Safi to Madhevere, no run, a well-directed bouncer down the leg-side, Wessly Madhevere lets it through to the keeper 100.2 Saleem Safi to Brian Bennett, 1 run, on the shorter side outside off, Brian Bennett rides the bounce, carving it through point for a single 100.1 Saleem Safi to Brian Bennett, no run, on the shorter side, Brian Bennett rides the bounce and taps it towards the keeper Over 100 377-5 B4 0 0 1 1 1 ( 7 runs) Brian Bennett 96 (172) Wessly Madhevere 50 (65) Ziaur Rahman Sharifi 18-3-65-0 Over Summary View all overs 99.6 Ziaur Rahman Sharifi to Brian Bennett, 1 run, pulled through the leg-side by Brian Bennett for a single 99.5 F Ziaur Rahman Sharifi to Madhevere, 1 run, on the shorter side around middle and leg, Wessly Madhevere pulls it through backward square leg for a single. Brings up his fifty and raises his bat 99.4 Ziaur Rahman Sharifi to Brian Bennett, 1 run, banged in short down the leg-side, Brian Bennett swivel-pulls it towards fine leg for a single 99.3 Ziaur Rahman Sharifi to Brian Bennett, no run, shortish delivery outside off, slower one, Brian Bennett ducks for cover 99.2 Ziaur Rahman Sharifi to Brian Bennett, no run, short ball down the leg-side, Brian Bennett goes for a pull and misses 99.1 4 Ziaur Rahman Sharifi to Brian Bennett, byes, FOUR , banged in short by Ziaur Rahman Sharifi, Brian Bennett goes for a pull, but gets beaten. The keeper can't collect it either, and the ball races away to the fence. The ball bounced just in front of him, hence he wasn't able to gather it cleanly Time for a drink! Afghanistan were adamant in overdoing the short ball and although they managed to beat the bat a few times, that plan hasn't yielded the desired results as yet. Zimbabwe will be extremely happy to have survived that phase and they will now look to get closer to 450 before lunch.. Over 99 370-5 1 0 1 0 0 0 ( 2 runs) Wessly Madhevere 49 (64) Brian Bennett 94 (167) Mohammad Saleem Safi 21-5-60-1 Over Summary View all overs 98.6 Saleem Safi to Madhevere, no run, short and well wide of off, Madhevere kneels down and lets it pass 98.5 Saleem Safi to Madhevere, no run, that's a good one from Mohammad Saleem Safi. Short and slanting down leg with extra bounce, Madhevere wanted to pull and withdrew his bat by dropping his gloves at the last possible instant FEATURED VIDEOS
